intro: Most Chanters on Global run one PvE build; the real choices are a separate PvP preset, a support bar for groups without a Cleric, a damage bar for premades, and how you farm. Each build below is drawn from at least three sites; where they disagree, it says so.
crosscheck: Other sources mostly agree with the main build. Top Global players and public builds run its four Stigmas: Undefeated Mantra, Sprint Mantra, Power of the Storm and Marchutan's Wrath (99/95/65/47% of 150 tracked players on metabot.gg; 62% of 595 public four-Stigma builds counted by aion2vault.com; gamerblurb.com's levelling set). Every source raises Dark Crush first and wants it at 16 to remove its cooldown. The main build's next three, Onslaught, Recuperation and Spinning Strike, match Grobs' level 45 build (aion2vault.com) and the Korean ranker order on aion2-meta.com. Where they differ: (1) Gust Rampage. The main build raises it to 10, but aion2-guides.info calls it not worth the points in Season 1, notXeon drops it once Dark Crush is 16 (aion2vault.com), and 72% of top Global players leave it below 8 (aion2-meta.com). (2) Dark Crush's picks at 16. The main build keeps Critical Hit on hit with the cooldown removal, as Grobs does. aion2-guides.info and the Korean meta on aion2-meta.com keep Piercing Strike with the cooldown removal and add the crit at 20; WallyJTV does the same (aion2vault.com). (3) The fourth Stigma. aion2-guides.info's base bar has Focused Defense in place of Sprint Mantra (Sprint Mantra goes back in for dungeons) and Marchutan's Wrath at 1; gamerblurb.com takes Focused Defense with a Cleric; aion2-meta.com said on 17 Oct that Marchutan's Wrath is no longer a must. (4) Passives. aion2-guides.info puts Inspiring Spell second, right after Attack Preparation; WallyJTV takes survival passives first (aion2vault.com).

builds.name: PvP Stun Chain
builds.role: Control fighter for duels, the arena and small fights
builds.summary: A second skill preset for PvP. You bait the enemy's Defiance with a stun, wait out its cooldown, then chain Impactful Crush, Wave Blow and Marchutan's Wrath into Dark Crush. Your PvE skill and Stigma levels stay as they are.
builds.when: Arena, duels, Spacetime Rifts and small Abyss fights. For big group fights, use the support build's bar.
builds.popularity: The main PvP setup on Global. On 21 Oct, 42 of 1,166 public Chanter builds on questlog were named or tagged PvP; of the 34 real PvP builds, 33 slot Undefeated Mantra and 27 Marchutan's Wrath (aion2vault.com). In Korea, 98.8% of top PvP Chanters run Marchutan's Wrath (aion2-meta.com). Creators: notXeon (Global, 6 Oct), and a Korean beginner's PvP guide (Aug).
builds.vsMain: The same core with these changes: Gust Rampage drops back to 1; Survival Willpower and Defiance go to 10; Wave Blow and Tremor Crush move up for the stun chain; Earth's Promise takes the 5 spare points. Specialties move to Stun, Seal and Knockdown picks. Fracturing Blow replaces Sprint Mantra until Guardian Blessing can reach 15.

stigmas.name: Undefeated Mantra
stigmas.why: +7.5% PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance for you and your group at 10; first to 20 later

stigmas.name: Marchutan's Wrath
stigmas.why: Opens Dark Crush from 20 m. With Stigma Shards: a 50% stun at 10, and -70% Incoming Heal and Potion Recovery at 15

stigmas.name: Power of the Storm
stigmas.why: Combat Speed and shorter cooldowns for the burst; every 90 s at 5

stigmas.name: Fracturing Blow
stigmas.why: A rush that takes 30% off their Defense for 5 s, strong even at low levels. Swap it for Guardian Blessing once you can take that to 15

builds.daevanion: Azphel: the core nodes first, then the Status Effect nodes. Sources split on PvP Damage Boost or Tolerance first, and on Status Effect Chance or Resist next; public Chanter boards take the four Damage Boost corners first. If PvP is your main content, aion2-guides.info's PvP route spends the PvE boards on Impactful Crush, Wave Blow and Defiance nodes instead.
builds.gear: Fierce Battle Amulet (PvP Damage Boost) in place of the Revelation Amulet. Brawler Wings (Status Effect Resist and Chance) or Talisra Wings. Status Effect Resist on armour. Survival Willpower and Blessing of Life lines on armour and jewellery in place of Wind's Promise (Korean advice). Saint of Ereshkigal as your Attack title. Stats: HP, PvP Damage Tolerance, PvP Accuracy and Status Effect Resist before damage. Keep one Genus preset for PvP.
play: Make them use Defiance first: open with Impactful Crush from 20 m and watch their buff bar for its icon.

Kite while their Defiance is on cooldown (45 to 60 s by different counts; Sprint Mantra helps on the ground). Then Impactful Crush or Marchutan's Wrath, Wave Blow on the stunned target, then Dark Crush and Spinning Strike.
Keep the macro for the damage line only. Press stuns, Wave Blow, Tremor Crush and defensives yourself.
Tremor Crush after a dodge catches runners. Use it the moment an immunity like Tenaciousness or Salvation ends.
Your Defiance doesn't break Root, Slow, Seal, Blind or Taunt. Their Defiance breaks your stun and knockdown, but not Spinning Strike's Seal.
Against Clerics and potion users, Marchutan's Wrath at 15 cuts their healing by 70%.
notXeon says stuns in a row don't get shorter. That is his observation, not something the game text says.
pros: Stuns, a Seal and a guaranteed knockdown to lock one target
Recuperation heals and cleanses you mid-fight
A preset of its own, so your PvE build is left alone
cons: Rarely bursts anyone down alone; sturdier classes win long fights
Rated B in PvP on aion2-meta.com and aion2atlas.app. Reddit names Spiritmasters and Templars as the hardest matchups (aion2data.com); a Korean guide names Gladiators
Guardian Blessing and Marchutan's Wrath only reach their PvP levels with Stigma Shards
Sprint Mantra does nothing in the Abyss, where you fight in the air

builds.disagree: The fourth Stigma is the main split. Guardian Blessing is in aion2maps.com's preset and in the most common public bar (aion2vault.com). notXeon takes it only at 15 and uses Fracturing Blow before that, which this build follows. Focused Defense: gamerblurb.com, dimach's public PvP build and the Korean guide. Obliterate: metabot.gg. Spinning Strike: most public PvP builds take the Seal; notXeon keeps the PvE picks. Wave Blow: aion2maps.com says its knockdown is the same at every level, so it raises Defiance in its place; aion2-guides.info takes it to 16. This build raises both.

builds.name: Support Healer
builds.role: Main support in groups with no Cleric, and group PvP
builds.summary: Swaps two damage Stigmas for Impeding Authority and Healing Touch, and takes the healing picks. You are still a buffer who also heals, not a second Cleric.
builds.when: Dungeons with no Cleric, groups still learning a fight, and Abyss or Rift group fights (notXeon's group bar).
builds.popularity: Rare on Global: Healing Touch is on 13% of top players' bars and Impeding Authority on 9% (metabot.gg), and each is on about 4% of public builds (aion2vault.com). It is more common in Korea, where Healing Touch is high on top players' lists (aion2-meta.com) and in Inven and DCInside guides. Creators: notXeon (Global).
builds.vsMain: Stigmas: Impeding Authority and Healing Touch replace Sprint Mantra and Marchutan's Wrath. Spinning Strike takes the Heal Boost pick. Points move from Gust Rampage to Defiance, and Blessing of Life and Protection Circle come earlier.

its boss debuff at 12 is party mitigation

stigmas.why: Always on; first to 20, unless a Cleric's Light of Protection already covers it

stigmas.name: Power of the Storm
stigmas.why: Kept in every notXeon bar; just before a stagger or big burst

stigmas.name: Impeding Authority
stigmas.why: Party shield within 40 m, +15% Defense at 5; for known raid-wide hits

stigmas.name: Healing Touch

builds.daevanion: The main route, but buy Recuperation's nodes as each board opens instead of after 45. For your own survival, take the Zikel Damage Tolerance corners earlier. Our reading of gamerblurb.com's defensive order.
builds.gear: Keep Attack: Blessing of Life turns it into Heal Boost. Then HP, Damage Tolerance and Cooldown Reduction (gamerblurb.com's defensive order). Arcana: Recuperation's Compass line; Mirror of Vigor (Illusion, cooldowns) is the full-support choice over Mirror of Magic.
play: Mantras on before the pull. Power of the Storm on the pull and again just before a stagger.
Recuperation twice in a row when the party takes damage or carries a debuff; both charges are back after 30 s.
Impeding Authority goes up just before a known raid-wide hit. Healing Touch is for emergencies, not on cooldown.
Attack between heals. Your heals scale with Attack, and your mantras matter more than an extra cast.
In group PvP, stay within 40 m of your team; chasing a kill takes your buffs and heals out of range.
On the ground (Rift fights), notXeon swaps Impeding Authority for Sprint Mantra.
pros: Lets a group with no Cleric clear normal content
Two party cleanses: Recuperation, and Healing Touch at 15
One bar covers both dungeons and group PvP
cons: Thin healing next to a Cleric; no resurrection
Fewer Dark Crush windows without Marchutan's Wrath
Healing Touch only removes debuffs from Stigma level 15

builds.name: Premade Damage
builds.role: Damage support for a premade group that has a Cleric
builds.summary: Fracturing Blow replaces Sprint Mantra: its -30% Defense raises the whole party's damage. Gust Rampage's points go to Defiance. Past 45, Guardian Blessing at 15 is the long-term swap for more critical damage.
builds.when: Premade dungeon and expedition groups that dodge well and have a Cleric. Also the endgame target once Stigma Shards come in.
builds.popularity: The most-liked public Chanter build on questlog, mourasb's 'Chanters2' (45 likes), runs this bar; 8% of public builds swap Sprint Mantra for Fracturing Blow (aion2vault.com). Guardian Blessing is in dimach's 'PvE' build (second most liked) and 9% of builds. It also appears on many top Global characters' Stigma lists (aion2-meta.com).
builds.vsMain: Fracturing Blow replaces Sprint Mantra. Defiance replaces Gust Rampage at 10. Passive order follows aion2-guides.info: Attack Preparation, Inspiring Spell, Wind's Promise, Impact Hit.

builds.daevanion: As the main build. aion2-guides.info puts Incandescent Blow's nodes with Dark Crush, Onslaught and Spinning Strike, ahead of Recuperation's.
builds.gear: As the main build. For Guardian Blessing later, raise Wind's Promise past 10 with gear lines and Arcana; dimach takes it to 20.
play: Agree with your Cleric on buffs: Undefeated Mantra and Light of Protection don't stack, and Power of the Storm can't land on someone who has Earth's Blessing.
Fracturing Blow at the start of each burst window, so the Defense cut covers the party's big hits.
Without Sprint Mantra the party moves slower, so call out dodges.
Past 45: Undefeated Mantra to 20 first. Then Guardian Blessing to 15 in Marchutan's Wrath's slot (dimach) for x1.5 Wind's Promise; Dark Crush and Spinning Strike's always-crit picks make that pay.
pros: More party damage than Sprint Mantra's move speed
Defiance gives you a stun break with damage tolerance in mechanics
cons: Loses Sprint Mantra's move speed and heal on hit
Guardian Blessing only pays off at Stigma level 15, which needs Stigma Shards

builds.name: Solo Levelling and Farming
builds.role: Solo questing, open-world packs and elites
builds.summary: The main engine with solo picks: HP absorbs while your gear is weak, Impactful Crush's area stun for gathered packs, and Rushing Smash's reset on kill to dash from pack to pack.
builds.when: Levelling to 45 and farming alone at 45 before your Wisdom Stones are done.
builds.popularity: Most levelling builds use the standard four Stigmas: 95 of 98 public builds with 'level' in the name (aion2vault.com). The swaps here are each creator's levelling advice: Grobs, WallyJTV and aLuckyRO (aion2vault.com), aion2-guides.info, metabot.gg and gamerblurb.com.
builds.vsMain: The first 203 points (levels alone) follow metabot.gg's levelling build. Gust Rampage stays at 10 for staggered elites, and Defiance stays at 1. Specialties take the AoE and absorb picks.

builds.daevanion: The main route. Buy Rushing Smash's Nezekan and Zikel nodes early if you farm a lot: at skill 12 it resets on each kill, from level 25 at the earliest.
builds.gear: Enough Accuracy that your hits land, then Attack, Combat Speed and Damage Boost (gamerblurb.com's levelling order). Add Healing Touch only if survival is what slows you down.
play: Packs: Rushing Smash in, Impactful Crush's area stun, then the Dark Crush line with Onslaught held.
Elites: Impactful Crush, Dark Crush, Wave Blow on the stunned target, Spinning Strike, Dark Crush again.
Keep weaving Onslaught: every hit restores MP.
Before Dark Crush reaches 16, press one opener by hand when Dark Crush is ready, so the macro doesn't waste a window.
Low HP: Recuperation; Sprint Mantra also heals on hits.
pros: Sturdy and quick solo, with self-heals
Rushing Smash's reset chains packs without downtime
cons: Absorb and AoE picks lose damage on bosses; switch to the main build's picks for dungeons
Clears slower than Gladiator or Spiritmaster (aion2atlas.app)
